opportunities.name: Tech lead research (HN + GitHub -> note)
opportunities.description: For a software project name, search Hacker News for the top story, search GitHub for the repo and get stars/latest release, then save a 'Lead' note summarising them.
steps: Search the project name on Hacker News (Algolia)
Note top story title, points, age
Search the project name in GitHub search and open the top repo
Note stars and latest release date
Open notes app, click New note, type the 'Lead: <project>. HN ...; GitHub ...' summary and press Enter

opportunities.name: Country fact-check (World Bank + BBC -> note)
opportunities.description: For a country, look up an indicator on World Bank Data, search BBC news for the country plus a topic, and save a fact-check note.
steps: Search the country on World Bank data
Search BBC for '<country> <topic>' and open a relevant article
Add a 'Fact-check <country>' note with the indicator and headline

opportunities.name: Company/case research (CourtListener search + Wikipedia)
opportunities.description: Search a company name on CourtListener for case law, and look it up on Wikipedia.
steps: Enter company name in CourtListener keyword search and submit
Search the same name on Wikipedia and open the article
